risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative detail on earnings, balance-sheet growth, capital, and credit metrics, but includes extensive standard forward-looking disclaimers and judgment-based accounting language. Credit risk remains material, reflected in elevated nonperforming assets, lost interest income, charge-offs, and reliance on estimates for loan-loss allowances and investment impairments. Overall performance and regulatory capital are presented positively, though improvement is partly offset by persistent troubled-loan exposure and increased long-term debt.
